messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — ran an adaptive KV-aware batching smoketest on staging combining replay traces + synthetic traffic. saw weird latency cliff around 1.2k tokens :thinking:
chris: can you drop the command you used?
maria: ran: ```./harness run --mode hybrid --replay-sample=0.6 --synthetic-dist zipf:1.2 --profile kernels,kv,batched --kernels auto --batch-heuristic latency-first --target-batch 8```
raj: did the kernel selector flip to the fallback path or to a different optimized kernel?
maria: selector flipped. for seq < 768 it stayed on fused-attn fp16, between 768-1400 it attempted fused-attn but kernel introspection chose the "emulated_attn" path at ~1024 boundary (more mem pressure).
lee: what about KV cache locality? were prefill-only requests hitting hot cache?
maria: prefill-heavy slice shows cache-miss ~18% (shockingly high). replay traces had ~70% prefill-dominant sessions, synthetic caused interleaved small gen bursts.
chris: 18% miss explains re-prefill churn and kernel churn. did batching combine requests across different kv-shards?
maria: yes batching merged shards naively. batch profiler output: 
```
Batch 0: 6 reqs (shards A,A,B,A,B,C) -> kernel switch at step 2
Batch 1: 4 reqs (shards B,B,B,B) -> stable
Avg batch latency (tail p95): 312ms -> 1120ms spike when shard-mix > 40% different
```
raj: try enabling shard-aware batching heuristic in harness: `--batch-heuristic shard-aware` and bump `target-batch=4` to reduce cross-shard merges. also test `--kernels prefer_fp16` to force smaller memory footprint.
lee: also pod-affinity for hot KV ranges could help. did you see an allocation spike on the serving nodes?
maria: yes allocation jumped ~1.9x during spike. flame graph shows kernel-selection cost increase (about 27% of CPU sampling) plus memcpy overhead from cache misses.
chris: curious about apples-to-apples: can you create a 1:1 synthetic-only run and a replay-only run with same seed and compare tails? need identical seqlen distribution and same batching params.
maria: doing that next. initial plan: synth-only zipf:1.2 with prefill-ratio 0.7, replay-only subsample to match seqlen histogram, run 12x 30m windows. also include `--profile raw-trace` for per-token kernel decisions.
raj: add experiment to capture `kernel_decision_log` and `kv_miss_log` per request id. we can then correlate kernel flip with miss/mem pressure.
lee: if kernel flip correlates with prefill boundaries, we may want an explicit hysteresis: keep fused-attn up to 1500 if memory predicted < threshold. avoids flip-flop.
maria: good idea. will prototype hysteresis in selector: `window=256 tokens, threshold=1.15x mem`. will push test tomorrow.
dev-bot: smoke-run started (id: smoke-176723) — will post completion summary when done. :rocket:
chris: thanks — would also love p95/p99 numbers and the % of batches that were cross-shard. those are the key metrics for the rollout decision.
maria: noted, posting raw csv once smoke-run completes.
